interpretation: All metrics are descriptive over supplied seeds; ranges are seed ranges, not confidence intervals. Native/grouped target hit@k is conditional on a detector producing an alarm explanation in that event. The unconditional counterfactual target-hit analysis uses every exact-target-complete event, with missed detections and unsuccessful counterfactuals counted as misses. Events with target names absent from the HAI CSV schema are excluded rather than mapped by guesswork. The result measures localization of documented target points, not causal root-cause identification.
